name: Start and restart remain playable
description: Verifies first-time play opens a short tutorial, the level starts cleanly, and restart restores responsive input.
steps: Open Jam Shift on a fresh save
Tap Play level 1
Read the quick guide and choose Got it — let's play!
Make an invalid swap then restart
Tap two adjacent candies
expected: First-time players receive a dismissible guide; level 1 starts with a fair board, restart clears stale activity, and controls respond again.

name: Tap and swipe controls both swap adjacent candies
description: Verifies both hint targets are highlighted and a goal-relevant legal move can be played using tap or swipe.
steps: Start a level and dismiss the guide if shown
Tap Hint and observe the two highlighted candies
Swap the hinted pair using taps
Restart and swipe a candy toward an adjacent cell
expected: The hint highlights both adjacent candies for a legal move; tap and swipe resolve valid swaps, while invalid swaps return cleanly.

name: Matches cascade, score and objectives update
description: Checks objective progress and cascade scoring settle correctly and board recovery leaves legal moves.
steps: Start a level
Make a valid match
Wait for falls and cascades to settle
Check score, moves and objective counter
Continue until the board reshuffles if no legal moves remain
expected: Successful moves consume one move, cascades update score and objectives, and any deadlock recovery preserves a full, match-free board with at least one legal move.

name: Special candy effects and combinations
covers: parallel striped combo clears both matching rows or columns
perpendicular striped combo clears a cross
description: Exercises special creation and combo effects through the visible gameplay flow.
steps: Play until a four-match creates a striped candy
Create a five-match color candy and an L/T wrapped candy
Activate specials and swap special pairs
Wait for chained clears to settle
expected: Match shapes create specials; special swaps clear their intended areas and consume both swapped candies, including when a stripe is swapped perpendicular to its blast direction, without leaving the board locked.

name: Level progression and booster economy
covers: level completion stars only after a win
campaign star total excludes failed attempts
description: Verifies chapter paging, genuine level completion, stars, sound feedback, booster accounting and saved progress.
steps: Open the level map
Switch to the next chapter and back
Open the current unlocked level
Equip and use one available booster on a candy
Verify the charge and move count change
Complete or lose a level, then reload
expected: The map shows ten levels per chapter, locked levels cannot be opened, stars and cleared levels are tracked separately, each booster use consumes one charge and one move, and progress remains available after reload.
